name: Punch Bowl Cake
author: Helen - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: box yellow cake mix (without pudding), baked as directed on package in 2 layers
large box instant vanilla pudding (prepared per box instructions)
cans pie filling (your choice of fruit)

instructions:
Crumble cake - will make 2-3-4 layers.

Layer order: 1. Cake, 2. Pudding, 3. Pineapple, 4. Bananas, 5. Pie Filling, 6. Cool Whip. Top with chopped nuts.

Spread each layer to edge, so it will look pretty on outside of bowl.
